messages:
Gina: Quick ping  WaveAI wants a 25m hosted PoC burst next Tue 11:45-12:10 PT. Theyll run a client harness (~160 clients, ~9 rps). Org: org-wave-55. Request: scoped key + temp token quota bump + IP allowlist. Also asking for an explicit billing cap on the scoped key.
Owen: What model + avg tokens? Need tokens/min to size quota and estimate cost.
Gina: Using /v1/generate with redwood-2.0-medium. Avg ~330 tokens. Ballpark: 160*9*330 = 475k tokens/min. Ask for 600k tokens/min for cushion.
Leah: Capacity looks OK if we reserve the us-west-2 pool. Recommend token_quota_per_minute=600000, concurrent_request_limit=220, valid_window=2026-11-09T19:45:00Z/2026-11-09T20:10:00Z (25m). We can pin routing_policy to fallback to redwood-1.3-small and add response header X-RW-Fallback-Model.
Mika: From security: scoped key only, IP allowlist required, mask prompt_text in logs, retention 3d, disable export. For billing cap: we can attach spend_limit_usd=500 to the key so it auto-disables at cap. Confirm contact for data questions.
Gina: Contact is infra@wave.ai. Yes on the $500 cap  they want to avoid surprise spend. Also want a header indicating model served so they can split cost metrics.
Leah: Sample admin API Ill run after IPs arrive: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org-wave-55","name":"wave-poc-burst","scopes":["gen:invoke"],"token_quota_per_minute":"600000","concurrent_request_limit":"220","valid_window":"2026-11-09T19:45:00Z/2026-11-09T20:10:00Z","routing_policy":{"fallback_model":"redwood-1.3-small","response_header":"X-RW-Fallback-Model"},"billing_caps":{"currency":"USD","spend_limit":"500"}}'
```
ops-bot: ACTION: reserving capacity on pool us-west-2 for tag \"wave-poc-burst\"  ticket INF-8133  reserved 700 rps-equivalent.
sec-bot: Confirmed: logs masked for prompt_text, retention 72h, exports disabled. IP allowlist pending. Will sign off once IP ranges received.
Leah: Ill attach an observability alert: page if 5xx > 1% for 3m OR median latency > 500ms, and auto-throttle/disable key if cross-customer impact or spend_limit hit.
Gina: IPs DMd. Please share the key securely when ready. Thanks all  will post results and any cost notes after the window.
Owen: Ill monitor during the window and verify we dont cause collateral impact. If spend_limit triggers, ops will notify the PoC lead.
Gina: Great, appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
